value.rationale: Expected outbreak duration and total infected count measure different epidemic burdens. The minimal four-node contact addition shows one can become smaller even as the other grows, while the complete smaller-graph nondecrease theorem shows this is a genuine sharp structural boundary, not an arbitrary parameter recomputation. Does not imply policy on real-world contacts.
